title.narrative: Accelerating agroforestry adoption, enhancing productivity and resilience in Sri Lanka

description.narrative: The project aims to achieve sustainable agricultural practices, enhance food security, and increase economic resilience for local communities by implementing integrated agroforestry and multi-cropping systems in tea production systems to improve Sri Lanka’s comparative and competitive advantage in the sector globally and, to develop climate adaptive and resilient agriculture livelihood systems through sustainable practices and technological interventions in a manner that can be widely adoptable, replicable and up scalable
